text.tspan: What wraps the encrypted GET /cart as it leaves the laptop's Wi-Fi card
L2 · 802.11 Wi-Fi frame (Ethernet on wired hops)
dst MAC = the router's · src MAC = the laptop's
src port 54370 → dst port 443 · seq/ack · flags PSH, ACK
TLS record (5 bytes + auth tag), between L4 and L7
Measured in the lab for plain HTTP: 153 bytes = 14 (Ethernet) + 20 (IP) + 32 (TCP) + 87 (HTTP)
